Foliore is free and open source software, licensed under the GPL-3.0.

Free and open source
Foliore is free software under the GNU General Public License version 3 (GPL-3.0). There are no purchases, subscriptions, or book limits. You may use, study, change, and share it under that license. The source code and the full license are available at %2$s.

No warranty
As the GPL-3.0 states, Foliore is provided “as is”, without warranty, to the extent permitted by applicable law. This does not exclude liability imposed by law or limit your rights.

Files and backups
Keep up-to-date copies of your books and important data outside Foliore. Sync also propagates changes and deletions and does not replace an independent backup. Before deleting data, changing devices, or uninstalling the app, check your copies. Recovery depends on the files and versions still available and may not be possible in every case. This notice does not exclude liability imposed by law or limit your rights.

Optional services
Google Drive, Gmail, Kindle, ChatGPT, and the OpenAI API are optional, and Foliore works without signing in to any of them. When you use one, its own terms apply. Requests made with your ChatGPT account count toward your plan’s usage. Requests made with an OpenAI API key are billed by OpenAI to that key’s account.

AI suggestions
Synopses, details, and covers suggested by AI may be inaccurate. Review them before saving. Covers found on the web belong to their rights holders; use them only in your personal library.

Compatibility and updates
Compatibility is stated on the Google Play app listing. Foliore is maintained on a best-effort basis, with no promise of new features or of working on every future Android version and device.

Support
For help, write to %1$s or open an issue in the project repository.
